headline: Stock market: Milan -2.1% with tech and banks; BTP soars to 4.67% - News - Ansa.it
summary: Piazza Affari traded at its session lows as tech and bank shares led losses. European bond markets sold off, especially peripheral government bonds, amid political instability in Spain.
why: The FTSE MIB is Italy's benchmark stock index, covering its largest listed companies. BTP yields reflect the borrowing cost of Italian government debt, a key gauge of euro-area sovereign risk.
why_moved: Bond sales hit peripheral government debt, and the report links this to political instability in Spain. Bank and tech shares then weighed on the index.
